thread:
sara (docs): Heads up 0: I'm updating our regions page to add an India note (ap-in) & a short data residency caveat. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1359. Need quick eyes from intl/platform/legal/devex.

priya (intl): On it. Quick translation note: we'll need hi-IN and en-IN variants. Also avoid translating 'data residency' literally; legal prefers a consistent phrase.

dan (platform): Clarification: we do not run Hosted API in India today. We can support Dedicated/Private deployments through partners. Suggest text: "Hosted API is not offered in India. Dedicated or Private deployments may be available via partners; contact Sales."

leo (legal): Minor tweak: include 'subject to applicable laws and export controls'. Proposed sentence for PR: "Hosted API is not offered in India. Dedicated or Private deployments may be available via partners; deployments are subject to applicable laws, export controls, and contractual terms."

priya (intl): Thanks. Also flag: some pages still reference an internal tracker URL (https://internal.redwood/regions-status-in)  please replace with https://www.redwood.ai/regions.

mira (devex): Snippet question: current docs show `X-Region: ap-in` in examples. That header will 403 against public Hosted API. We should show two snippets: one for Hosted (note: not available) and one for Dedicated/Private using `X-Region`. Proposed for PR: ```js
// Dedicated/Private (use region header)
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY',
    'X-Region': 'ap-in'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'hello' })
})
``` And add a future-hosted placeholder note rather than a host example so users don't try `in.api.redwood.ai`.

sara (docs): Good point. Mira: can you add a short runtime note that sending `X-Region: ap-in` to Hosted endpoints will return 403/unsupported, and point to the partner contact link?

mira (devex): Yup. Also proposing to add a small Console screenshot callout: Console region selector shouldn't show 'India (ap-in)' for Hosted tier to avoid confusion. I can update the screenshot after merge.

dan (platform): FYI: For Dedicated/Private in India partners, we require customer-managed KMS and local audit logs. Add a one-liner for security/compliance.

leo (legal): Add this legal-approved clause into the PR (exact wording): "Data residency commitments in India are provided only under specific contractual arrangements and may require compliance reviews and export-control assessments."

priya (intl): I'll add i18n TODOs for hi-IN and en-IN and queue translations after copy freeze. Also will remove that internal link.

sara (docs): Plan: 1) Sara updates PR with revised snippet + 403 note + legal sentence. 2) Priya wires i18n TODOs and removes internal link. 3) Mira updates console screenshot after merge. 4) Dan confirms platform wording. Target: merge by next Wednesday. Any blockers?

dan (platform): No infra blockers. We'll coordinate partner page publish with Marketing if needed.

leo (legal): No blockers. Approving the text once it's in the PR.

sara (docs): Thanks all :rocket: I'll push updates in ~45m and add reviewers.
